name: Glute Bridge
summary: A floor-based hip extension that trains the glutes with minimal equipment. It is a good starting point for the hip thrust and for glute activation.
setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor about hip width apart.
Place your heels about a foot from your hips and rest your arms by your sides.
Gently brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
execution: Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top until your knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Pause briefly, then lower your hips under control.
cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top: tuck the pelvis and lift only until the body is in a straight line.
Pushing through the toes so the hamstrings take over: place the feet closer and drive with the heels.
Letting the knees fall in or out: keep them in line with the toes.
Rushing the reps: pause at the top and lower slowly.
